snippet.title: Val'ty alpha trailer.
snippet.description:
Val’ty is a short first-person game being developed in Godot.

It combines shooting, exploration, and a few side activities. 
You play as Val’ty, a 46-year-old alien mother on a quest to destroy a machine built to transform rebel alien species into servants. The game isn’t trying to be the next great boomer shooter, you only have one gun, and the focus is on uncovering secrets and easter eggs, which are essential to reach the ending.

* It's not a +18 game like most of other creations.
* It's inspired by games like MDK, Turok and Chasm The Rift
* You can command Val'ty's daughter to access areas and solve simple puzzles.
* Game Difficult can be changed anytime.
* Meet and talk to NPC's  (mostly Val'ty's girlfriends).
* It features a hub area, if you've played my previous games you know how much I like Hub areas.
